title: Chapter 294: The Strength Of The Zerg Clan Is Fully Demonstrated
content:
Chapter 294: The Strength Of The Zerg Clan Is Fully Demonstrated

Wu Qing added two new soldiers, Zerg Scorpions and Zerg Mammoths, to the battle, adding four thousand five-star Zerg Devourers that found a way to attack the ground, allowing the Zerg army to successfully contain the powerful night offensive of the alien army.

A large number of Zerg puppies launched a fierce attack on the plague-infected areas of the alien army and the attack areas of the five-star Zerg Devourers, successfully cutting off the ground offensive of the alien army.

Ten six-star Zerg Scorpions can continuously restore energy and skill status, and can maintain the existence of the plague area for a long time.

Ten six-star Zerg Mammoths can easily rush into the formation of the alien army without fear of any threat, and kill a bloody path for the Zerg puppies, cut the formation of the alien army at will, and create conditions for the Zerg puppies to surround and annihilate the enemy.

Five thousand five-star Zerg Devourers sprayed mucus attacks, attacking a position, and special spores will infect the alien army in a large area around it.

Their continuous attacks caused more and more of the alien army to be infected, creating an excellent opportunity for the Zerg dogs attacking on both wings to annihilate the enemy.

The pressure on the main combat arms of the Zerg was reduced, and they finally got a chance to rest.

A large number of Zerg main combat arms went directly underground to rest and recover, leaving only some troops in better condition outside to continue to assist the Zerg dogs in blocking the attack.

The Zerg army, after burrowing underground, recovered much faster and soon had the strength to fight again.

Wu Qing did not choose to upgrade the main combat arms of the Zerg on a large scale. Through the reasonable use of several Zerg ultimate arms, he successfully blocked a powerful attack of the aliens.

There were 5,000 five-star Zerg Devourers guarding the front of the battle. The flying arms of the alien army no longer dared to come to participate in the battle. They came to participate in the battle, almost to die.

Unless the aliens sent a large number of five-star flying arms, it would be difficult for them to gain an advantage in air combat.

On the ground battlefield, the offensive channel of the alien army was affected by the ten expanding plague areas in the middle, and the forward position was affected by the attack of the Zerg Devourer, which created excellent offensive conditions for the Zerg Puppies.

The Zerg army wiped out the alien army that entered the defense range of the Zerg main combat arms. It was very difficult for the alien army to deploy such a large number of troops to the front line again in a short time.

The Zerg army only needed Zerg puppies and a small number of Zerg destroyers to carry out uninterrupted attacks, which basically blocked the ground attack of the alien army.

In the 996 cities of the aliens, a large number of troops could not be quickly deployed to the front battlefield, and could only attack the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions in other directions.

The alien army ignored the Zerg puppies lurking underground, and slowly killed back to the lost city wall step by step and reoccupied the city wall.

The battle situation was temporarily stalemated. The aliens continued to accumulate troops while waiting for the plague area created by the Zerg scorpions to disappear. Under normal circumstances, large-scale battlefield magic, even auxiliary magic, has a duration limit.

Six-star Zerg scorpions release plagues every once in a while. With their six-star strength, as long as they do not release a large number of plagues continuously in a short period of time, they can fight until dawn with the current release frequency.

Of course, Wu Qing did not naively think that only ten six-star Zerg scorpions, plus ten six-star Zerg mammoths and five thousand Zerg Devourers, could always block the attack of the alien army.

The number of Zerg ultimate arms is still too small.

When the enemy's strength is strong to a certain extent, ten plague areas and five thousand five-star Zerg Devourers will also lose their effect, and they will eventually need to rely on the hard power of the Zerg.

The alien army took the initiative to attack the Zerg puppies in other directions of Jiujiuliu City, which would consume the Zerg troops and prepare to expand the front in other directions.

As long as the battle line is long enough, the role that a small number of powerful Zerg troops can play is limited.

Wu Qing's guess soon came true. Two armies led by the elite troops of the alien race in the 996 city of the alien race broke out of the city wall from the left and right positions of the Zerg main combat troops' positions and launched a counterattack against the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

Facing the organized elite troops of the alien race, even if the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions have the combat power of one-star troops, they can't resist and are soon killed by the alien army.

The endless alien army, like a stream of water blocked in the main channel, quickly diverted to the left and right channels and rushed to the left and right flanks of the Zerg main combat troops' positions.

The flying troops in the alien army were also all deployed to the left and right fronts, causing the Zerg blocking troops with insufficient anti-aircraft firepower to suffer a more tragic blow.

Without saying anything, Wu Qing selected 14,000 injured and poorly-conditioned one-star Zerg Dragons and immediately evolved and upgraded them.

He evolved and upgraded 9,000 of them into five-star Zerg Air Guards, and 5,000 into five-star Zerg Devourers.

After their evolution and upgrading, the number of five-star Zerg Air Guards and five-star Zerg Devourers on the battlefield reached 10,000.

The 10,000 five-star Zerg Air Guards were divided into two teams, providing firepower support to the Zerg Puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions on the left and right fronts.

The five-star Zerg Sky Guardians, under the command of the Queen, specifically attack the important positions of the alien attack forces, creating favorable battlefield conditions for a large number of Zerg blocking forces.

Ten thousand five-star Zerg Devourers were also divided into two groups, each leading a part of the Zerg Dragons to fly at high speed to the left and right fronts.

Five thousand five-star Zerg Devourers, working together with the Zerg Dragons, quickly repelled the alien air forces that returned.

The two Zerg air forces stayed in the air above the left and right fronts to support the ground Zerg Zerglings and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions.

In the game setting, the range of the Zerg Devourer is much longer than that of the Zerg Hydralisk. In the real world, the Zerg Hydralisk is considered a long-range attack unit, and the Zerg Devourer can be classified as an ultra-long-range attack unit.

In addition, the Zerg Devourer has a height advantage, and the range when attacking the ground will be longer.

After repelling the alien air force, five thousand five-star Zerg Devourers were deployed to support the ground outside the range of the alien army's long-range arms.

The terrible mucus and the ubiquitous special spore infection quickly curbed the offensive of the alien army, which was no different from the situation on the main front.

…

For the next whole night, the alien army took advantage of the continuous reinforcements to attack the Zerg army in various ways and continuously consumed the Zerg army's manpower.

Wu Qing took advantage of the abundant resources to continuously upgrade and evolve the Zerg army to deal with various battlefield situations.

After a whole night of fierce fighting, the alien army finally failed to capture the position of the Zerg army's main combat arms.

But both armies suffered heavy losses, and every moment, thousands of combat soldiers on both sides disappeared.

As soon as the sky got light, the aliens stopped attacking. They did not defeat the Zerg army that lost its reinforcements, let alone the Zerg army that received reinforcements after the sun rose.

The aliens switched from attack to defense, and all retreated to the 996 city to continue to defend.

After a night of fighting, the aliens actually understood that if the Zerg army really wanted to capture the 996 city during the day, they would have a hard time defending it.

But the aliens were unwilling to retreat like this, so they could only continue to increase their troops and temporarily defend the 996 city.

At dawn, a large number of reinforcements set out from the first Zerg sub-base underground in the 66th city and rushed to the battlefield.

Those Zerg puppies that were closer to the 996 city of the aliens had already arrived at the battlefield in advance to supplement the Zerg puppies that suffered the most serious losses last night.

Wu Qing told the Queen that they could attack the 996 cities of the alien race appropriately, mainly to kill the alien race's living forces and earn resources. As long as the alien race army did not retreat voluntarily, they should not launch a full-scale attack.

After commanding the battle for a day and a night, Wu Qing was very tired, so he returned to his body and went to rest.

…

The performance of the Zerg army on the battlefield was spread to all directions through the spectators of various forces in the local camp.

The identities of the spectators this time were extremely complicated. They belonged to not only those big clans and big forces, but also many medium and small forces, and even some powerful individuals came to watch the battle.

Therefore, the performance of the Zerg was widely spread outside. The local camp has not had a race as powerful as the Zerg for a long time.

By the way, the best app for reading and listening to books at present, Yeguo Reading, install the latest version.

"The decline of the alien race is obvious. Unless they break the rules and send strong men to join the war, they will not be able to recover from the suppression of the Zerg!"

"I heard that only a force of the alien race came to the public battlefield this time. I wonder if they still have a way to defeat the Zerg army in conventional combat!"

"As the Zerg army's arms are gradually enriched, it is difficult for anyone to defeat them in conventional combat! Their only shortcoming is that the main combat arms are a little less!"

"Who knows how many troops the Zerg still have? So, this is not a shortcoming!"

"As long as the Zerg are in the public battlefield, If they defeat the alien race on the battlefield, their chances of obtaining the status of a great clan will greatly increase. It will depend on how many great clans support them then!"

"The Goblins should nominate the Zerg, it depends on what the other great clans think!"

"As long as they have the strength, even if they can't get the status of a great clan this time, they will get it soon. The strength of the general great clan is probably not as good as that of the Zerg. As long as the Zerg dares to make trouble, they are not afraid that other great clans will not help them speak!"

"..."

All forces have recognized the strength of the Zerg great clan, but everyone has different opinions on whether the Zerg can obtain the status of a great clan.
